{{Top|leg}}
The '''heavy bonded plates''' [[Armor accessory|enhancement]] increased the protection capabilities of [[Armor/Legends|armor]] against many types of damage. However, the added safegaurd impaired the movement of the wearer to some degree. The Mark I, II, & III versions in turn allowed for a considerable increase in protection, in addition to further diminishing movement.

==Behind the scenes==
In [[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords|''KotOR II'']], this upgrade can only be used on heavy armor.
